description: X=33 jailbreak column LUT TT codec — per-position per-nibble cell sets. (Y=4, N=4) is Stage A position from cl_* mining; (Y=4, N=6) is Stage B position from rcl_* (reverse cross_lab) mining. Both verified 100% predicted-vs-observed across 6 variants and 100% hit on cl_and gold for the Stage B set. [v2 2026-05-03: filtered CRC byte artifacts (off-32)%210>=208]

mining_source.(4, 4): scripts/cross_lab/x33_lut_mining/v_cl_*.v (Stage A varies, Stage B fixed buffer)
mining_source.(4, 6): scripts/cross_lab/x33_lut_mining/v_rcl_*.v (Stage B varies, Stage A fixed buffer)

note_per_bit_within_nibble: Per-bit assignment within a nibble is UNKNOWN (mining used only 2-input functions, all bits in a nibble flip together). For 4-input LUTs at X=33, this codec will over-emit cells when only some bits within a nibble are set. Re-mine with 4-input function variants to refine.
note_crc_filter: CRC bytes (last 2 bytes of each 210-byte frame, frames 25..1751) excluded — they were 70-90% of v1 nibble cells but are CRC side-effects of upstream changes, not real LUT TT bits.
